verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation such as hooks is a fair question for a coding-agent CLI, but the evidence pack shows no way to define rules that fire actions automatically on events. The closest items are adjacent features: agent rules files are instruction context, permission keys map actions to allow/ask/deny, and Tab-queueing a message is a manual sequencing aid. None of these are event-driven triggers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
